name: quiet-regular-lore
description: The Quiet Regular — interactive lore repository (Vite + TypeScript).

scripts.build: npm run prepare:data && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.build:single: npm run prepare:data && tsc --noEmit && vite build --config vite.singlefile.config.ts
scripts.quality: npm run prepare:data && tsc --noEmit && eslint . && vitest run && node scripts/validate-assets.mjs && npm run audit:prod
